look_here_first: Start with fruit size and leaflet narrowness. Little walnut is the smallest-fruited local walnut: fruits about 1.4–2.3 cm and nuts about 1.1–1.7 cm, with 17–25 narrow leaflets. It is usually a shrub or small tree rather than a massive canopy tree.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: shrub or small tree, generally to about 10 m

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: nut about 1.1–1.7 cm with longitudinal grooves and relatively smooth surfaces between grooves

lookalikes.differences: J. major has fewer, broader leaflets and larger 2–3.5 cm fruits; J. nigra has much larger 3.5–8 cm fruits and a coarsely warty nut surface.
